description: Sedes Abastecimento Sistema de Transposição is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Compilação de dados sobre a infraestrutura hídrica e transposições instaladas na RHII. Arquivo vetorial contendo a seleção das sedes dos municípios atendidos pelo sistema Guandu-Lajes-Acari. Metadados administrados pela Gerência de Gestão do Território e Informações Geoespaciais (GEGET), setor pertencente à Diretoria de Biodiversidade e Áreas Protegidas e Ecossistemas - DIBAPE. Consulte também:. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
